text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: INC12345 — latency SLO breach. Metric: p99 > 1200ms for /v1/generate (model=redwood-large, region=eu-west). SLO burn: 12% over last 10m. Paging eng-oncall.

Raghu: picking this up. acking PD. link: https://pd.example/incidents/INC12345

pd-bot: PagerDuty: Incident INC12345 acknowledged by Raghu

Mike: ack. seeing p95 ~ 650ms, p99 ~ 1550ms in eu-west. Dashboards: https://dash.example/redwood/latency?region=eu-west

Sylvia: any recent deploys or canaries?

Raghu: small canary 55 minutes ago for connection-pool tuning, no errors in canary logs. checking cluster events and autoscaler.

Raghu: looks like a sudden spike in node preemptions in the gpu-hotpool. Node events show many "Preempted" from cloud provider in the last 8m. Possible spot reclamation.

L2-oncall: can confirm from node-events:
```
kubectl get events --field-selector involvedObject.kind=Node -n kube-system | tail -n 20
2026-03-15T09:12:10Z node/gpu-node-23 Preempted by cloud-provider
2026-03-15T09:14:02Z node/gpu-node-17 Preempted by cloud-provider
```

Mike: that would fragment the GPU pool and cause fewer available inference workers -> higher tail latency. Good catch.

Raghu: immediate mitigations:
- bump min replicas for gpu-autoscaler to 6
- mark gpu-hotpool as non-preemptible (if cloud permission allows)
- route a portion of traffic to redwood-dedicated-eu until pool stabilizes

Raghu: patching autoscaler now:
```
kubectl patch hpa gpu-inference-hpa -n inference --type merge -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":6}}'
```

Raghu: also updating traffic routing: switching 20% of production traffic to dedicated capacity (redwood-dedicated-eu) via routing-config. Doing canary shift now.

support-bot: Support alert: elevated latency reports from EU customers. Top impacted orgs: AcmeCorp (high), Nova Labs (medium). No widespread 5xxs reported yet, mostly timeouts >2s.

Sylvia: checking kernel OOM/dmesg on preempted nodes. If processes get killed, some sidecars may restart slowly.

L2-oncall: I can standby for a rollback of the canary if scaling+routing doesn't help. Requesting logs from the canary pods:
```
kubectl logs -n inference deploy/canary-connpool -c inference --since=30m | grep -i error | tail -n 50
```

Raghu: autoscaler patch applied. Requesting additional nodes; cloud API shows provisioning new non-preemptible nodes (request id cloud-req-789).

pd-bot: Incident INC12345 escalated to L2 oncall after 8m of ack without resolution.

Mike: after scale + route, p99 dropped to ~420ms over the last 2 minutes. SLO burn now down to ~2%. Will continue to monitor.

Raghu: good, keeping increased capacity for 20m then reduce. Not rolling back canary for now.

Sylvia: confirmed preemptible node count dropped to 0 for gpu-hotpool; cloud metrics show preemption events have stopped.

Ava: coordinating with support — sending interim customer update: "We're seeing elevated latency in EU for some customers; engineers have applied mitigations and p99 is improving. We'll follow up in 30 minutes with a full post-incident summary." :thumbsup:

Raghu: adding notes to incident ticket INC12345 with mitigation timeline and commands used.

Raghu: handing off to night shift @Ava at 23:00 UTC to monitor for recurrence. If p99 rises above 800ms again, please escalate and call L2.

Mike: logging final stats for thread: p95 peak 700ms, p99 peak 1600ms, mitigated to p99 ~420ms after scaling & routing.

Raghu: leaving this thread open for 1h post-handoff. Thanks everyone. :clap:
